column1: # FC,D/F+2 is TWO different moves in the source:
# - FC df+2,1 = Shady Lotus to FC (low stance version, returns to neutral)
# - FC DF+2 = Shady Lotus to Rain Dance (high version, transitions to RDS)
# The FD source lumps both into one row with combined frame values.
# Patch: keep FC d/f+2,1 row (rename), rewrite FC D/F+2 to only have RDS version frames.
# (FC, → FC space is handled globally by normalize_fc_prefix)
# Frame data - Shady Lotus / Lotus Twist fix
# Movelist - Shady Lotus / Lotus Twist fix
# FC d/f+4 has no frame data of its own; delete it so FC d/f+4,4 splits into both hits.
# D+3,2,1,4 is from full crouch - use FC prefix with space.
